title: North train leaving station before 1907
description: Looking west down Orser Street (originally Station Street, later King Street), this photo dates from before the 1907 fire, evidenced by the Keith & Plummer original store visible in the background. Citizens are seen leaving the train station platform after meeting the northbound train, some greeting arrivals, others saying goodbye to departing passengers, or simply watching as the train continues north.
